scheme: YYYY.MM.N: N counts, within the month, the changes of METHODOLOGY.md or of the scoring code that move a published score. A version is named when it is pushed on-chain. methodVersionDate is the date of that push (UTC, ISO). The methodologyHash stays the machine identifier; this is the readable name next to it.
after_each_push: Fill `hashes` of the version that was pending (read them from the oracles or from the push output), set its status to "on-chain", then add the next pending version. scripts/lib/method_version.py reads this file.
